title: The The Ending of Yesterday's Chapter
youtube_title: The The Ending of Yesterday's Chapter | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Quiet attention can be warmer than advice.
summary: At a porch while rain ticks and nobody is late, Nana Ruth begins to tell Delia about an ending of yesterday's chapter, which the teller needed to retell. Delia wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
